samples.scenario: Azure Blob Storage container configured with public read access was found exposing internal financial reports. An attacker enumerated containers using unauthenticated REST API calls and downloaded sensitive XLSX files containing quarterly earnings and employee bonuses.

technical_data.Sample_Azure_Blob_Listing_Request:
GET /quarterly-reports?restype=container&comp=list HTTP/1.1
Host: finreportsprod.blob.core.windows.net
User-Agent: curl/7.68.0

samples.detection_method: Azure Security Center scans for blob containers with public access enabled. Azure Monitor and diagnostic logs track anonymous read operations. Network security appliances detect unusual access patterns and unauthorized blob downloads. Regular policy compliance checks enforce private access for sensitive containers.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: Google Cloud Storage bucket used for web application static content was misconfigured with uniform bucket-level access disabled, allowing public read access to sensitive debug logs containing user session tokens and internal API keys. An attacker enumerated the bucket via public URLs and downloaded log files for credential harvesting.

technical_data.Sample_GCS_Bucket_Listing_Request:
GET /storage/v1/b/webapp-static-assets/o?prefix=debug HTTP/1.1
Host: storage.googleapis.com
User-Agent: Wget/1.20.3 (linux-gnu)

samples.detection_method: Google Cloud Security Command Center detects buckets without uniform bucket-level access and flags public IAM bindings. Audit logs are monitored for anonymous access attempts to sensitive object paths. Network IDS correlates suspicious user agents with unusual IP addresses. Periodic manual IAM policy reviews ensure compliance.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: An Azure Blob Storage container was configured with public read access, exposing sensitive financial reports to the internet. Attackers enumerated the container via unauthenticated REST API calls and downloaded confidential quarterly financial statements using curl commands.

IAM_Policy_Misconfiguration.AccessLevel: Blob (Public read access for blobs only)

technical_data.Sample_Blob_Container_Listing_Request:
GET /finance-reports?restype=container&comp=list HTTP/1.1
Host: financestorage.blob.core.windows.net
User-Agent: curl/7.68.0
technical_data.Sensitive_File_Snippet:
Report Title: Q2 2024 Financial Summary
Revenue: $12,500,000
Net Income: $3,200,000
Confidential - For internal use only.

samples.detection_method: Periodic Azure Security Center scans detect containers with public read access. Azure Activity Logs analyzed for anonymous blob read operations. Network monitoring alerts on unusual public blob downloads with uncommon user agents. Azure Policy enforces private container access unless an exception is approved.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object

samples.scenario: A Google Cloud Storage bucket was misconfigured with 'allUsers' granted 'roles/storage.objectViewer' permission, exposing sensitive internal project documentation. Attackers identified the bucket via open-source intelligence and downloaded confidential PDFs using gsutil without authentication.

technical_data.Sample_GCS_Bucket_Listing_Request:
GET /storage/v1/b/internal-project-docs/o HTTP/1.1
Host: storage.googleapis.com
User-Agent: gsutil/5.11
technical_data.Sensitive_File_Snippet:
Project: NextGen Platform
Status: Confidential
Reviewed by: Engineering Leads
Next Steps: Complete integration tests by July 2024.

samples.detection_method: GCP Security Command Center scans IAM policies for public access bindings. Audit logs monitored for unauthenticated storage object GET calls. Alerting on gsutil user agents from unfamiliar IPs accessing sensitive buckets. Cloud IAM policies enforced with alerts on 'allUsers' permissions.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1530 - Data from Cloud Storage Object
